product_media_id_valid.name: product_media_id_valid
product_media_id_valid.value: substr("product_media"."id", 1, 5) = 'pmed_' AND length("product_media"."id") BETWEEN 10 AND 80 AND "product_media"."id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'

product_media_alt_text_valid.name: product_media_alt_text_valid
product_media_alt_text_valid.value: "product_media"."alt_text" IS NULL OR ("product_media"."alt_text" = trim("product_media"."alt_text") AND length("product_media"."alt_text") <= 500)

product_variants_option_topology_check.name: product_variants_option_topology_check
product_variants_option_topology_check.value:
(
            ("product_variants"."is_default" = true AND "product_variants"."option_combination_key" IS NULL)
            OR
            ("product_variants"."is_default" = false AND trim(coalesce("product_variants"."option_combination_key", '')) <> '')
        )

media_dimensions_positive.name: media_dimensions_positive
media_dimensions_positive.value: ("media"."width" IS NULL OR "media"."width" > 0) AND ("media"."height" IS NULL OR "media"."height" > 0)

media_lifecycle_timestamps_valid.name: media_lifecycle_timestamps_valid
media_lifecycle_timestamps_valid.value:
(
        ("media"."status" = 'ready' AND "media"."trashed_at" IS NULL AND "media"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("media"."status" IN ('trashed', 'deleting') AND "media"."trashed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("media"."status" = 'deleted' AND "media"."trashed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
    )

media_upload_handle_valid.name: media_upload_handle_valid
media_upload_handle_valid.value:
(
        ("media_upload_sessions"."state" IN ('initializing', 'failed') AND "media_upload_sessions"."upload_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("media_upload_sessions"."state" NOT IN ('initializing', 'failed') AND "media_upload_sessions"."upload_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("media_upload_sessions"."state" = 'failed' AND "media_upload_sessions"."upload_id" IS NOT NULL)
    )

media_upload_completion_timestamps_valid.name: media_upload_completion_timestamps_valid
media_upload_completion_timestamps_valid.value:
(
        ("media_upload_sessions"."state" = 'committed' AND "media_upload_sessions"."r2_completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media_upload_sessions"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("media_upload_sessions"."state" <> 'committed' AND "media_upload_sessions"."committed_at" IS NULL)
    )

order_return_receipt_lines_movement_shap.name: order_return_receipt_lines_movement_shape
order_return_receipt_lines_movement_shap.value:
(
        ("order_return_receipt_lines"."restock_quantity" = 0 AND "order_return_receipt_lines"."inventory_movement_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("order_return_receipt_lines"."restock_quantity" > 0 AND "order_return_receipt_lines"."inventory_movement_id" IS NOT NULL)
    )

order_returns_active_claim_shape.name: order_returns_active_claim_shape
order_returns_active_claim_shape.value:
(
        ("order_returns"."active_order_key" IS NULL
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_key" IS NULL
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_hash" IS NULL
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_type" IS NULL
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_started_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("order_returns"."active_order_key" = "order_returns"."order_id"
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_hash" IS NOT NULL
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_type" = 'receive'
            AND "order_returns"."active_command_started_at" IS NOT NULL)
    )

checkout_inventory_lane_movements_shape_.name: checkout_inventory_lane_movements_shape_check
checkout_inventory_lane_movements_shape_.value:
"checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."pool" = 'regular'
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane" BETWEEN 0 AND 31
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."operation" IN ('released', 'deducted')
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."quantity" > 0
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane_capacity_before" >= 0
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane_reserved_before" >= "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."quantity"
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane_reserved_after" = "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane_reserved_before" - "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."quantity"
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane_version_before" >= 0
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane_version_after" = "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."lane_version_before" + 1
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."source_stock_version_before" >= 1
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."source_stock_version_after" = "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."source_stock_version_before"
                + CASE WHEN "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."operation" = 'deducted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."stock_before" >= 0
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."stock_after" = "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."stock_before"
                - CASE WHEN "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."operation" = 'deducted' THEN "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."quantity" ELSE 0 END
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."legacy_reserved_stock_before" >= 0
            AND "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."legacy_reserved_stock_after" = "checkout_inventory_lane_movements"."legacy_reserved_stock_before"

delivery_locations_active_child_name_uid.name: delivery_locations_active_child_name_uidx
delivery_locations_active_child_name_uid.where: "delivery_locations"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "delivery_locations"."is_active" = 1 AND "delivery_locations"."type" IN ('zone', 'area') AND "delivery_locations"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL

order_discount_allocations_code_shape.name: order_discount_allocations_code_shape
order_discount_allocations_code_shape.value:
(
            ("order_discount_allocations"."method" = 'automatic' AND "order_discount_allocations"."promotion_code" IS NULL)
            OR
            ("order_discount_allocations"."method" = 'code'
                AND "order_discount_allocations"."promotion_code" IS NOT NULL
                AND length("order_discount_allocations"."promotion_code") BETWEEN 3 AND 50
                AND "order_discount_allocations"."promotion_code" = upper(trim("order_discount_allocations"."promotion_code")))
        )

order_discount_allocations_target_shape.name: order_discount_allocations_target_shape
order_discount_allocations_target_shape.value:
(
            ("order_discount_allocations"."target" IN ('line', 'order')
                AND "order_discount_allocations"."order_item_id" IS NOT NULL
                AND "order_discount_allocations"."quantity" IS NOT NULL
                AND "order_discount_allocations"."quantity" > 0)
            OR
            ("order_discount_allocations"."target" = 'shipping' AND "order_discount_allocations"."order_item_id" IS NULL AND "order_discount_allocations"."quantity" IS NULL)
        )

promotion_codes_identity_valid.name: promotion_codes_identity_valid
promotion_codes_identity_valid.value:
"promotion_codes"."code" = trim("promotion_codes"."code")
            AND "promotion_codes"."normalized_code" = upper(trim("promotion_codes"."code"))
            AND length("promotion_codes"."normalized_code") BETWEEN 3 AND 50
            AND "promotion_codes"."normalized_code" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9_-]*'

promotion_conditions_config_shape.name: promotion_conditions_config_shape
promotion_conditions_config_shape.value:
coalesce((
            ("promotion_conditions"."kind" = 'minimum_merchandise_subtotal'
                AND json_type("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.amountMinor') = 'integer'
                AND json_extract("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.amountMinor') BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991
                AND json_type("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.currencyCode') = 'text'
                AND length(json_extract("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.currencyCode')) = 3
                AND json_extract("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.currencyCode') = upper(json_extract("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.currencyCode'))
                AND json_extract("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.currencyCode') NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*')
            OR
            ("promotion_conditions"."kind" = 'minimum_item_quantity'
                AND json_type("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.quantity') = 'integer'
                AND json_extract("promotion_conditions"."config", '$.quantity') BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
        ), 0)

promotion_effects_config_valid.name: promotion_effects_config_valid
promotion_effects_config_valid.value: json_valid("promotion_effects"."config") AND json_type("promotion_effects"."config") = 'object' AND length("promotion_effects"."config") BETWEEN 2 AND 4000

promotion_effects_config_shape.name: promotion_effects_config_shape
promotion_effects_config_shape.value:
coalesce((
            ("promotion_effects"."kind" = 'percentage_off'
                AND json_type("promotion_effects"."config", '$.basisPoints') = 'integer'
                AND json_extract("promotion_effects"."config", '$.basisPoints') BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)
            OR
            ("promotion_effects"."kind" = 'fixed_amount_off'
                AND json_type("promotion_effects"."config", '$.amountMinor') = 'integer'
                AND json_extract("promotion_effects"."config", '$.amountMinor') BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991
                AND json_type("promotion_effects"."config", '$.currencyCode') = 'text'
                AND length(json_extract("promotion_effects"."config", '$.currencyCode')) = 3
                AND json_extract("promotion_effects"."config", '$.currencyCode') = upper(json_extract("promotion_effects"."config", '$.currencyCode'))
                AND json_extract("promotion_effects"."config", '$.currencyCode') NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*')
            OR
            ("promotion_effects"."kind" = 'free' AND json("promotion_effects"."config") = '{}')
        ), 0)

promotion_redemptions_code_shape.name: promotion_redemptions_code_shape
promotion_redemptions_code_shape.value:
length("promotion_redemptions"."promotion_code") BETWEEN 3 AND 50
            AND "promotion_redemptions"."promotion_code" = upper(trim("promotion_redemptions"."promotion_code"))
            AND "promotion_redemptions"."promotion_code" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9_-]*'

promotions_title_length.name: promotions_title_length
promotions_title_length.value: "promotions"."title" IS NULL OR length(trim("promotions"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

promotions_redemption_limits_ordered.name: promotions_redemption_limits_ordered
promotions_redemption_limits_ordered.value:
"promotions"."max_redemptions" IS NULL
            OR "promotions"."max_redemptions_per_customer" IS NULL
            OR "promotions"."max_redemptions_per_customer" <= "promotions"."max_redemptions"

promotions_spend_budget_shape.name: promotions_spend_budget_shape
promotions_spend_budget_shape.value:
(
            ("promotions"."max_discount_spend_minor" IS NULL AND "promotions"."budget_currency_code" IS NULL)
            OR
            ("promotions"."max_discount_spend_minor" >= 1
                AND length("promotions"."budget_currency_code") = 3
                AND "promotions"."budget_currency_code" = upper("promotions"."budget_currency_code")
                AND "promotions"."budget_currency_code" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*')
        )

promotions_schedule_valid.name: promotions_schedule_valid
promotions_schedule_valid.value: "promotions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at"

pages_static_fields_valid.name: pages_static_fields_valid
pages_static_fields_valid.value: "content_type" = 'article' OR ("excerpt" IS NULL AND "author" IS NULL AND json_array_length("tags") = 0)

navigation_menu_items_target_shape.name: navigation_menu_items_target_shape
navigation_menu_items_target_shape.value:
(
            "navigation_menu_items"."target_type" IN ('page', 'category', 'collection', 'product')
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("navigation_menu_items"."target_id")) > 0
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_value" IS NULL
        ) OR (
            "navigation_menu_items"."target_type" IN ('system', 'internal_path', 'external_url')
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_id" IS NULL
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_value" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("navigation_menu_items"."target_value")) > 0
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_query" IS NULL
        ) OR (
            "navigation_menu_items"."target_type" = 'label'
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_id" IS NULL
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_value" IS NULL
            AND "navigation_menu_items"."target_query" IS NULL
        )

navigation_menu_items_target_query_shape.name: navigation_menu_items_target_query_shape
navigation_menu_items_target_query_shape.value:
"navigation_menu_items"."target_query" IS NULL OR (
            length("navigation_menu_items"."target_query") BETWEEN 2 AND 1024
            AND substr("navigation_menu_items"."target_query", 1, 1) = '?'
            AND instr("navigation_menu_items"."target_query", '#') = 0
        )

                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_id" IS NOT NULL
                AND length(trim("navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_id")) > 0
                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_value" IS NULL
            ) OR (

                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_id" IS NULL
                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_value" IS NOT NULL
                AND length(trim("navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_value")) > 0
                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_query" IS NULL
            ) OR (
                "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_type" = 'label'
                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_id" IS NULL
                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_value" IS NULL
                AND "navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_query" IS NULL
            )

navigation_publication_items_target_quer.name: navigation_publication_items_target_query_shape
navigation_publication_items_target_quer.value:
"navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_query" IS NULL OR (
                length("navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_query") BETWEEN 2 AND 1024
                AND substr("navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_query", 1, 1) = '?'
                AND instr("navigation_menu_publication_items"."target_query", '#') = 0
            )

navigation_placements_supported_location.name: navigation_placements_supported_location
navigation_placements_supported_location.value:
(
            ("navigation_placements"."surface" = 'header' AND "navigation_placements"."slot" = 'primary' AND "navigation_placements"."position" = 0)
            OR
            ("navigation_placements"."surface" = 'footer' AND "navigation_placements"."slot" = 'column' AND "navigation_placements"."position" BETWEEN 0 AND 3)
        )

tax_rates_jurisdiction_label_length.name: tax_rates_jurisdiction_label_length
tax_rates_jurisdiction_label_length.value: "tax_rates"."jurisdiction_label" IS NULL OR length("tax_rates"."jurisdiction_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 180

tax_rates_jurisdiction_shape.name: tax_rates_jurisdiction_shape
tax_rates_jurisdiction_shape.value:
(
            ("tax_rates"."jurisdiction_type" = 'all' AND "tax_rates"."jurisdiction_id" IS NULL)
            OR
            ("tax_rates"."jurisdiction_type" IN ('city', 'zone', 'area') AND length("tax_rates"."jurisdiction_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 180)
